rv.q: This radically reinvented The Amazing Technicolor Dreamcoat is about as fabulous as it gets.
Their JOSEPH…is bright, heartfelt, and endlessly entertaining—a celebration of imagination, music, and storytelling.
This coat of many colors may not entirely live up to its dream.

cn.t: This revival reinvents the Lloyd Webber-Rice classic with fresh energy and Gen Z appeal, delivering colorful theatrical joy through strong performances, though some question whether the production fully comes together.
